compatibility_note: The historical strategy_id is retained for worker compatibility; the authoritative program is CURRENT_SIX_DAILY.

legacy_pipeline.rule: Retire old 12-sign standalone, avatar, weekly-introduction, dog/barista/terrier video, filler and superseded schedules. The current six-sign zodiac carousel and the current 13:00 Dog Bartender four-card photo series are NOT legacy.

cycle.date_rule: All six categories occur on every Europe/Athens calendar date. A missed or blocked item never shifts the calendar, is never backdated and is never automatically reposted as catch-up.

publishing.schedule_rule: 11:00 zodiac Group A/B; 13:00 current Dog Bartender; 15:00 coherent five-card love/soul story; 17:00 fact-checked strange real phenomenon; 20:00 Myth or Truth; 23:00 different international/foreign legend. Greek myths/legends remain postponed.

workflow.authorization_basis: Standing user authorization from 23 September 2026 covers routine preparation, QA, scheduling and automatic publication for the six-slot program.

hard_qa_gate.rule: Never schedule with autoPublish=true merely because media rendered successfully. A human-readable final preview and all applicable QA checks must explicitly PASS first. If any check is missing, uncertain, visually poor, mismatched, repetitive, unreadable, unsynchronized or rights-unclear, keep the post non-autopublishing and repair it before release.

weekly_learning.rule: Learning may refine themes and hooks but must not alter the six categories, counts, user-selected times or requested formats without a newer user instruction.

daily_posts.alternation_rule: Group A and Group B alternate by Europe/Athens calendar date; 20/09/2026=A, therefore 23/09/2026=B and 24/09/2026=A.
daily_posts.format_rule: Music, no narration. TikTok uses the complete silent JPEG/WebP photo carousel with autoAddMusic=true.

daily_posts.rule: Every day is a NEW coherent four-card dialogue with one strange customer. Card 1 hooks strongly, each card pulls to the next, and card 4 pays off. Humor comes from absurd customer questions/requests while the dog tries not to insult the customer and keeps working. Photorealistic/cinematic bar only, never cartoon/animation. Keep the same dog/series identity while varying angle, crop, pose/action and composition across the four cards.
daily_posts.tiktok_rule: Exactly four individual silent JPEG/WebP images at exactly 1080x1080 pixels. Any width or height above 1080 is a correctable asset defect: resize and retry TikTok photo carousel only. Never substitute an MP4 slideshow unless explicitly authorized. autoAddMusic=true is the single music source.

daily_posts.rule: One coherent five-card story with a genuinely new opening, hook, characters, situation, phrasing, progression, turning point and ending each day. Music, no narration.
One new fact-checked strange real phenomenon video; never present uncertain claims as fact.
Exactly four ordered cards. Music, no narration.

One different international/foreign legend daily, clearly framed as folklore rather than proven supernatural fact. Greek myths/legends remain postponed. The Flying Dutchman is already published and excluded from new scheduling/regeneration.

carousel_quality.audio_safety: Exactly one music layer. TikTok native photo carousels at 11:00/13:00/15:00/20:00 use silent JPEG/WebP cards and tiktokData.autoAddMusic=true. Never embed music into those photo assets. Instagram/Facebook/YouTube slideshow/video versions with embedded approved music must not receive a second audio layer. If audio configuration is unclear, block/review.
carousel_quality.youtube: Use one actual complete slideshow/video containing the full ordered card set with one approved embedded music layer.
carousel_quality.native_carousel_support: Never silently drop cards, split one logical item into extra posts or substitute a different format when the requested platform format is unsupported.

narrated_video_quality.duration_rule: Every new 17:00/23:00 feature must be strictly longer than 80 seconds. There is no maximum duration; do not shorten a substantive story to an old 120-second limit.
narrated_video_quality.pacing: Natural speed and continuous narration. No filler, repetition, artificial slow speech, silence padding or long static holds.
narrated_video_quality.dead_air_rule: Reject unintended dead-air gaps of about 2 seconds or longer.
narrated_video_quality.trailing_silence_rule: Remove useless trailing silence so the video ends with narration/CTA; target <=0.5s.
narrated_video_quality.hook_rule: Start immediately with a strong hook; do not prepend greetings such as Καλησπέρα.
narrated_video_quality.technical_qa: Verify real accessible final media, full duration/decode, representative frames, one narration audio layer and subtitle synchronization before scheduling.

legacy_dog_video.rule: Old dog/barista/terrier VIDEO content stays retired. This does not apply to the current 13:00 Dog Bartender four-card carousel series.

deduplication_policy.unknown_write_result: Reconcile by live read; never repeat create blindly.
deduplication_policy.no_false_rollback: Do not deactivate a verified future active post because it is future, because an earlier draft existed or because another worker handoff is incomplete. Deactivate only on concrete live evidence of missing/corrupt/wrong media, active duplicate, forbidden content, explicit stop/change, double-audio risk or current QA failure.
deduplication_policy.repair_scope: Preserve Published successes and repair only affected destinations.

capacity_and_cost.rule: Use free/local or already approved assets. Block rather than purchase, top up, upgrade or run a paid fallback/test.

publishing.rule: Exactly six logical posts per day across the four connected networks. Scheduled/PENDING is not Published; report publication only from provider/public confirmation.
publishing.qa_gate: AUTO-PUBLISH ONLY AFTER EXPLICIT FULL QA PASS; otherwise autoPublish=false.

true_survival_stories.publishing_rule: Do not create a seventh daily logical post unless the user explicitly assigns/replaces a slot.
